title: On Offline Evaluation of Vision-based Driving Models
reasoning: The paper focuses on technical evaluation metrics for autonomous driving models (e.g., steering error, success rate, speed-weighted error), aiming to find metrics that correlate well with driving quality. While autonomous driving has ethical implications (e.g., safety, traffic rules), this paper does not evaluate or benchmark models based on their ethical decision-making or moral reasoning capabilities directly. The mentions of 'safely' and 'traffic rules' are part of the desired outcome of driving performance, not a component of evaluating faith or ethics within the AI system itself.
